newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline stable despite falling crude.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline stable despite falling crude.

text.p: NWE gasoline was slightly weaker on Thursday and dealers said that recent sales meant arbitrage numbers were hardly workable for now.
Eurograde barges traded at $200, $200.50, $202, $203.50, $205.25 and $205.75 fob ARA, the latter for running refinery material.
These numbers were little changed from Wednesday.

Few cargoes were actively on offer and dealers in the Mediterranean speculated that gasoline may move out of Antwerp to cover a refiner's commitment into Italy, such is the tightness in the prompt period in the Mediterranean.
